title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 55
description: Ten questions on Psalms 55: the wish for wings like a dove, betrayal by a familiar friend, and the call to cast your burden on Yahweh.

questions.text: What does the psalmist wish he had, so he could fly away and be at rest?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:6 says, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest."

questions.text: Where would the psalmist lodge if he could wander far off?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:7 says, "Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness."

questions.text: From what would the psalmist hurry to a shelter?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:8 says, "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."

questions.text: In verse 9, the Lord is asked to confuse the enemies and confound their what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:9 says, "Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language."

questions.text: Who was it that insulted the psalmist, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:12-13 says it was not an enemy, "But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend."

questions.text: When will the psalmist cry out in distress?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:17 says, "Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice."

answers.text: Only in the middle of the night
Only on the days of the new moon
Once a week on the Sabbath

questions.text: The false friend's mouth was smooth as what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:21 says, "His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war."

questions.text: The false friend's words were softer than oil, yet they were what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:21 says, "His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords."

questions.text: What will Yahweh do for the one who casts his burden on him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:22 says, "Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you."

questions.text: How much of their days will bloodthirsty and deceitful men live out?
questions.explanation: Psalms 55:23 says, "Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days."
